author: reek
body: badge-widget bound a colour in all five arms and used it in none, so every badge in the tree rendered untinted. A BadgeStyle now carries the tone the constructor already knew when it chose the colour.

author: reek
body: The colours are the control. They are unchanged by this, and a tone derived from a colour rather than from the meaning would still make the tone rows pass while saying nothing, so both are printed side by side.
